metadata.article_title: Amendment of Register by order of Court.

article.title: Amendment of Register by order of Court.
article.content: A Court deciding any matter relating to a registered firm may direct that the Registrar shall make any amendment in the entry in the Register of Firms relating to such firm which is consequential upon its decision; and the Registrar shall amend the entry accordingly.
article.html:
65Amendment of Register by order of Court.

Section 65 · Chapter VII · page 17 of the Act

A Court deciding any matter relating to a registered firm may direct that the Registrar shall make any amendment in the entry in the Register of Firms relating to such firm which is consequential upon its decision; and the Registrar shall amend the entry accordingly.
